column1: # Provider hostname -> backbone, used to pre-fill the Backbone field in the
# wizard from the server hostname the operator already typed.
# WHY THIS EXISTS: article numbers are handed out by the BACKBONE, so two
# accounts on one backbone must share crawl state and two different backbones
# must not. Getting that wrong silently loses articles (see PROVIDERS.md), and
# free-typed text is a poor way to get it right. Matching the hostname turns a
# guess into a lookup.
# PROVISIONAL. This is a small hand-kept list of well-known mappings, not a
# complete provider database. Backbone deals change — providers switch upstream,
# get acquired, or multi-home — so treat every row as a hint, never as truth:
# nothing here is applied silently, it only pre-fills a field the operator can
# see and correct.
# TODO: replace with a properly-licensed, maintained dataset. A good public
# source exists (usenet.rexum.space) but is "all rights reserved" with no repo,
# so its data is not vendored here; the intent is to ask for a licence or find
# an openly-licensed equivalent, then generate this file from it.
# Tab-separated; # comments. Columns:
#   domain      registrable domain to match; a host matches if it equals this
#               or ends in "." + this (so news.eweka.nl matches eweka.nl)
#   backbone    the backbone key to pre-fill
#   confidence  confirmed = seen in provider/backbone data directly
#               likely    = widely published, not independently verified here
#   notes       optional
# domain
